en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a rustic thatched-roof hut, captioned 'Un Bohio — A Cuban Hut.' The landscape is rural, with sparse vegetation and a few palm trees. The card has handwritten text in Spanish on the front, including a date and personal message. The typography at the bottom mentions Habana (Havana), and 'Wilson's Obispo 41 y 43, Habana' as the publisher details.
